title: From the Void
description: An abstract geometric painting on a black background featuring a central circular target-like motif with radiating segments in teal, purple, yellow, and white. Bold angular shapes, lightning-bolt zigzags, and dynamic brushstrokes in bright pink, cyan, orange, and yellow radiate outward with visible paint splatters and textured marks.
prompt: Abstract geometric painting with a central circular target motif in teal, purple, white and yellow segments on a black background. Bold angular triangles, lightning bolt zigzags in bright yellow and pink, dynamic paint strokes and splatters in cyan, orange and magenta radiate outward creating high contrast and energetic movement. Street art meets modern abstract style with visible brush texture.
